# comment: AI-READI device-derived measurements mapped to HPO. Subjects are b2ai:cardiac_ecg.<manifest column> (the Philips 12-lead device's own interval and rate measurements, one row per recording, config/aireadi/modalities/cardiac_ecg.yaml) and b2ai:wearable_blood_glucose.<statistic> (window summaries over the 10-day Dexcom G6 series, config/aireadi/modalities/wearable_blood_glucose.yaml). EVERY ROW IS A MEASURED-VALUE MAPPING (evidence_code ECO:0007307) with a skos:relatedMatch predicate and a reference-range gate, on the same terms as b2ai-aireadi-measurement.sssom.tsv. THRESHOLDS - ECG rate and PR per the AHA/ACCF/HRS 2009 recommendations for the standardization and interpretation of the electrocardiogram (sinus bradycardia < 60, sinus tachycardia > 100 bpm; first-degree AV block PR > 200 ms, normal 120-200); QTc per the same (prolonged > 450 ms men, > 460 ms women), stratified by sex via when_subject with a sex-blind fallback (present only where abnormal for both sexes, > 460; absent only where normal for both, <= 450). The device's QTc formula is Bazett per the Philips DXL algorithm. NOT MAPPED - QRS duration (bundle-branch block is a morphology diagnosis, not a duration cut-point), the axes, and the device's own interpretation strings, which AI-READI states are not physician-reviewed. CGM - the glucose management indicator gates Hyperglycemia at the international consensus target (GMI >= 7.0 %, Battelino et al. 2019); confidence 0.7 pending clinical review, present pole only, since a 10-day window at target does not rule out hyperglycemia at other times. Wearable (Garmin) summaries derive no feature.
